title: Wear app: Double tapping the "Digital Style" watchface graph area no longer changes graph resolution
symptom: Double tapping the Wear App "Digital Style" watchface graph area no longer changes graph resolution. Graph resolution can be changed through settings as usual.
cause: The tap area is incorrectly placed; tapping on the weekday name changes the scale, not the graph area.
evidence_quote: When I tap multiple times on weekday name, the scale is changing. Yes the tap area is moved incorrectly.
